subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction hook names and payloads to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: This changes a public plugin API and likely sets cross-channel reaction semantics, so code inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the permanent contract shape safely.

options.title: Approve generic observation hooks
options.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while leaving room for Slack/Matrix/WhatsApp parity.

options.title: Scope to Discord first
options.body: Accept a Discord-first contract now, with explicit follow-up requirements so cross-channel payload drift does not become permanent.

options.title: Defer the API surface
options.body: Keep reaction automation on system events or external workarounds until maintainers are ready to sponsor a broader plugin-hook design.

recommendation.title: Approve generic observation hooks
recommendation.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while leaving room for Slack/Matrix/WhatsApp parity.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin hook/context work and review metadata make this the best available owner for the public hook-contract decision, with Discord input from steipete likely needed.
